reason: split_cents_exact violates Req 1 ('shares summing strictly to total_cents'). (1) Negative totals: exact-to-floor uses int() (truncation toward zero) instead of math.floor, so rem goes negative and order[:rem] is wrong; split_cents_exact(-100, [1,1,1]) returns [-32,-32,-33] (sum -97). (2) When total_w <= 0 it returns [0]*n, which does not conserve a nonzero total_cents. The only test covers a positive total with equal weights, so neither case is caught. Fix by using math.floor and handling the zero/negative-weight case explicitly, then add tests for negative totals and degenerate weights.
